text.p: These are the leading stories in the Botswana press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A Bill under which members of parliament will have to declare their assets within three months after their election will be presented to parliament in February.
- The bi-annual Botswana International Trade Exhibition (BITEX), last held in 1994, will not resume until after 1998 because of low attendance figures and rising costs, organisers said.
- Namibia is trying to persuade United States-based General Motors to move a "semi knocked down" (partially assembled) production line, due to open in Botswana this year, to its region.
- Air Botswana and South African-based Comair are close to an agreement to share air traffic.
